_comment: DS-6 seed parity (ADR-067 spec SC-012). One row per model in the retired pkg/providers/capabilities 1.0.0 seed (78 rows, generated from that file at test-authoring time). seed_* is what the pre-ADR-067 media pipeline resolved; expected_* is what the ADR-067 catalog resolves for the same (canonical provider, model) pair. divergence=none rows are the real parity oracle. divergence=corrected rows changed because the registry disagrees with the hand-written seed; divergence=retired rows are absent from the registry snapshot entirely and fall to the FR-004 miss defaults. Every non-none row names its correction_source.
